You know, I was just thinking about how unpredictable spring weather can be - one day it's sunny, the next it's pouring rain. Makes planning outdoor activities quite the gamble!

Anyway, to your question about the British monarchy: Queen Anne died in 1714 without surviving children. She was succeeded by George I of the House of Hanover, who was her second cousin. George was chosen because he was the nearest Protestant relative, as the Act of Settlement 1701 had excluded Catholics from the succession.

Answer: George I (George Louis of Hanover) succeeded Queen Anne to the throne in 1714.

Confidence: 100%
